title: Token Burn TUI
description: Glanceable quota view modeled on the token-burn TUI: one block per account, stacked used/forecast/free bars plus window detail.

panels.title: claude/claude-default
panels.description: Quota bar per window: used / forecast to reset / free.

queries.query: WITH u AS (SELECT s.window AS win, s.value AS val FROM "token_burn_usage_used_percent" s JOIN (SELECT window, max(_timestamp) AS latest FROM "token_burn_usage_used_percent" WHERE provider = 'claude' AND account_id = 'claude-default' GROUP BY window) mu ON s.window = mu.window AND s._timestamp = mu.latest WHERE s.provider = 'claude' AND s.account_id = 'claude-default'), f AS (SELECT s.window AS win, s.value AS val FROM "token_burn_forecast_projected_reset_percent" s JOIN (SELECT window, max(_timestamp) AS latest FROM "token_burn_forecast_projected_reset_percent" WHERE provider = 'claude' AND account_id = 'claude-default' GROUP BY window) mf ON s.window = mf.window AND s._timestamp = mf.latest WHERE s.provider = 'claude' AND s.account_id = 'claude-default'), base AS (SELECT u.win AS win, u.val AS used, CASE WHEN f.val IS NULL OR f.val <= u.val THEN 0 WHEN f.val >= 100 THEN CASE WHEN u.val >= 100 THEN 0 ELSE 100 - u.val END ELSE f.val - u.val END AS fc FROM u LEFT JOIN f ON u.win = f.win) SELECT replace(win, '_', ' ') AS "x_axis_1", 'used' AS "breakdown_1", used AS "y_axis_1" FROM base UNION ALL SELECT replace(win, '_', ' '), 'forecast', fc FROM base UNION ALL SELECT replace(win, '_', ' '), 'free', CASE WHEN 100 - used - fc < 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100 - used - fc END FROM base ORDER BY "x_axis_1" ASC

panels.title: claude/claude-default windows
panels.description: Window detail: used %, hours to reset, burn %/h, projected % at reset (uncapped).

queries.query: WITH u AS (SELECT s.window AS win, s.value AS val FROM "token_burn_usage_used_percent" s JOIN (SELECT window, max(_timestamp) AS latest FROM "token_burn_usage_used_percent" WHERE provider = 'claude' AND account_id = 'claude-default' GROUP BY window) mu ON s.window = mu.window AND s._timestamp = mu.latest WHERE s.provider = 'claude' AND s.account_id = 'claude-default'), r AS (SELECT s.window AS win, s.value AS val FROM "token_burn_usage_seconds_to_reset" s JOIN (SELECT window, max(_timestamp) AS latest FROM "token_burn_usage_seconds_to_reset" WHERE provider = 'claude' AND account_id = 'claude-default' GROUP BY window) mr ON s.window = mr.window AND s._timestamp = mr.latest WHERE s.provider = 'claude' AND s.account_id = 'claude-default'), b AS (SELECT s.window AS win, s.value AS val FROM "token_burn_forecast_burn_rate_percent_per_hour" s JOIN (SELECT window, max(_timestamp) AS latest FROM "token_burn_forecast_burn_rate_percent_per_hour" WHERE provider = 'claude' AND account_id = 'claude-default' GROUP BY window) mb ON s.window = mb.window AND s._timestamp = mb.latest WHERE s.provider = 'claude' AND s.account_id = 'claude-default'), p AS (SELECT s.window AS win, s.value AS val FROM "token_burn_forecast_projected_reset_percent" s JOIN (SELECT window, max(_timestamp) AS latest FROM "token_burn_forecast_projected_reset_percent" WHERE provider = 'claude' AND account_id = 'claude-default' GROUP BY window) mp ON s.window = mp.window AND s._timestamp = mp.latest WHERE s.provider = 'claude' AND s.account_id = 'claude-default') SELECT replace(u.win, '_', ' ') AS "x_axis_1", round(u.val, 1) AS "x_axis_2", round(r.val / 3600.0, 1) AS "x_axis_3", round(b.val, 2) AS "x_axis_4", round(p.val, 1) AS "x_axis_5" FROM u LEFT JOIN r ON u.win = r.win LEFT JOIN b ON u.win = b.win LEFT JOIN p ON u.win = p.win ORDER BY "x_axis_1" ASC

panels.title: Legend
panels.markdownContent:
### Bar legend

- **used** (dark green): current provider-reported usage
- **forecast** (light green): projected additional usage by reset (`max(0, projected - used)`, capped at 100 on the bar; the table's `reset ~%` stays uncapped)
- **free** (gray): remaining capacity if the forecast holds

Windows without a forecast sample show only used/free.

### Adding an account

Blocks are fixed per provider/account. To add one (e.g. antigravity), duplicate a bar+table panel pair and replace the `provider = '...'` and `account_id = '...'` literals in both queries.
